mutations.label: E1 the endpoint-consumer scan is WIDENED to a status set, which is the change #1203e2 measured and refused: 26% false positives on a HARD blocker (20 of 27 candidates really unreferenced, 7 genuinely called including GET and POST /api/videos), against #1203a5's record of one false block costing a whole run
E2 the MCP-tool scan is widened the same way, where the case against it is stronger still -- 2379 corpus tools are `implemented` against 9 `defined`
E3 the `or "defined"` default is dropped, so a record with NO status reaches the scan -- and the consumers registry is known to be under-populated (#1203b0), so that turns straight into false blocks
